verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents a spec-first design workflow: you author OpenAPI specs in a design editor with a generated preview and automatic linting. A community user confirms replacing Swagger Editor with it. However, the import/export page lists OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 among formats that are explicitly labeled as import formats, so exporting the designed spec as an OpenAPI file is only implied by native OpenAPI authoring, not documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of OpenAPI export from a design document, hands-on corroboration of the export path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can design an API spec-first and export it as OpenAPI

citations.quote: Build and iterate on your OpenAPI specs to design your next API.
View a generated preview of your spec in the right pane.
Automatically linted. Errors display at the bottom of the center pane and include error type, line number, and error message
I can now stop spinning up swagger editor in a container and work with this.
